method: Assistant visual inspection of six encoded chapter sheets, six dense gag sequences and a 960x540/60fps temporal preview. Sampled review, not manual inspection of every frame.
notes: Boxing-glove preparation, impact, duck and recovery read as a short sequence.
Double seesaw launch keeps flying characters inside wide shots.
Cube wheel gag includes balancing, chase, reversal and recovery.
Sneeze and safety cable generate a second zero-gravity action beat.
Multiball adds rapid evasions and a late impact.
Final duck lands on the black character and follows the head during the reaction.
All chapter titles and player controls are English.
